## Where procurement strategy meets analytics

I'm Alyssa, a global procurement leader who has built and scaled sourcing organizations across retail, consumer, and digital commerce brands. Today I lead Global Indirect Procurement at Ralph Lauren, and I'm earning an MS in Applied Business Analytics at Boston University to bring sharper data to the decisions procurement makes every day.

## Why analytics, why now

Procurement sits on some of the richest data in any company: every supplier, every contract, every dollar that leaves the building. Yet analytics is one of the least invested-in capabilities in the function. As supply-chain volatility, cost pressure, and AI change how fast organizations need to act, I went back to school to build the technical foundation (SQL, Spark, cloud platforms, and data visualization) to lead that shift.

## What I bring

- **Strategic Sourcing** - category strategy, supplier negotiation, and vendor performance
- **Enterprise Transformation** - building procurement functions, procure-to-pay and ERP rollouts, M&A integration
- **Analytics & Insight** - spend visibility, KPI dashboards, and hands-on Python, SQL, and Spark

## Career goals

I want to lead procurement organizations where analytics is a core capability, not an afterthought: predictive spend insight, early supplier-risk signals, and decision tools that help teams move faster with confidence.

## Beyond the office

I serve as Senior Community Council Head with the New York Junior League, where I'm redesigning how the League captures and reports volunteer impact.
